status: Declared after literature and extraction QA, before any ethanol kinetic fit; not blinded or independently preregistered
reference_role: Dominant energy in published population mixture; not single-energy ground truth or statistical acceptance band
pixel_sensitivity: Primary window, fixed prefactor, free baseline: 4 corners of T offset +/-1.5 px and signal +/- extraction bounds; engineering scenarios, not probabilistic coverage
screen: >=30 finite pairs; strictly increasing T; no interpolation; missing columns omitted from fits but retained in source CSV
weights: Uniform weight per recovered raster column; columns and symbol pixels are correlated; no statistical parameter CI or MC
stopping_rule: Run declared cases once; retain all failures. Do not tune windows or models to recover reference. No MC or multistate fitting in this comparison.
fixed_method: Assessment harness profiles nonnegative scale and optional bounded baseline, optimizes energy using production simulate_tpd; production fitter has no fixed-prefactor argument.
free_method: Production fit_polanyi_wigner; energy, prefactor, positive scale and optional baseline optimized; order fixed at one.
independent_check: Analytic first-order survival with independent adaptive quadrature, evaluated only at completed primary fixed-prefactor/free-baseline result; same model, not independent experimental validation
